dedupe_keys.name: historical wind direction across singapore 2020 series on data gov sg

description: Historical Wind Direction across Singapore (2020 (series on data.gov.sg) is a series of datasets listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by National Environment Agency. Historical wind direction across Singapore. All timestamps are provided in Singapore Time (SGT), formatted in ISO 8601. ⠀ Disclaimer: This dataset may contain missing records and has not undergone quality control procedures applied to climate data and records. For official climate records or climate data reports, please contact salesclimo@nea. gov. sg. Coverage: Singapore. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher National Environment Agency. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-05-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
